messages.subject: Meridian Quarter, Leeds - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up earlier. As discussed we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the acquisition of Meridian Quarter at Wellington Place in Leeds. We're buying through a fresh SPV (Halbrook Meridian Propco Limited). Heads of terms are close to agreed with Tarncliffe at £14.75m, though we expect to chip the price on diligence. Funding will come 60% from Pennine Business Bank.

Can you get an engagement letter across and we'll kick off?

Isobel

messages.subject: RE: Meridian Quarter, Leeds - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Isobel,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is attached - day-to-day conduct will be with James Osei, with Elena Marchetti assisting. We've cleared AML on Halbrook and the SPV.

We'll order searches once you confirm the budget and will review the title and tenancy pack as soon as Pendle Voss send it. I note the £14.75m headline and the expectation of a reduction following diligence.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
